title: 'Godzilla El Niño' is wreaking havoc with Philippine central bank's inflation forecasts
summary_full: The Philippine central bank is running policy scenarios for a severe El Niño on top of the oil shock, with inflation at a three-year high.
summary_public: The Philippine central bank is running policy scenarios for a severe El Niño on top of the oil shock, with inflation at a three-year high.
